questions.question: The Indian National Science Academy is situated in _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• INSA consists of distinguished **scientists and engineers** from various science and technology fields elected as **Fellows of the Academy**.
 
• INSA conducts various activities such as organizing **scientific meetings, conferences, seminars, and workshops, **and awarding fellowships and medals to recognize outstanding contributions to science.
 
• INSA also advises the government on scientific matters and works towards promoting **science education **and the popularization of science in the country.

• **Bangalore, **also known as Bengaluru, is a hub of scientific research and development in India, with institutions such as the** Indian Institute of Science,** the **Indian Space Research Organization**, and the **National Aerospace Laboratories. **

questions.question: 'The state shall endeavour to secure to all workers a living wage and and a decent standard of life'. Which of the following is correct about the given statement in the context of india?

options.text: It is mentioned in the 43rd Article of the Constitution.
It is mentioned in the 44 th Article of Constitution.
This is a Gandhian principle of Directive Principles of State Policy.
This is a liberal principle of Directive Principles of State Policy.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It is mentioned in the 43rd Article of the Constitution.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given statement "The state shall endeavor to secure to all workers a living wage and a decent standard of life" is mentioned in the 43rd Article of the Constitution of India.
 
• This statement is a part of the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP),** which are** non-justiciable**, meaning they are not enforceable by law.
 
• DPSPs are guidelines for the government to frame policies and make laws that promote the** welfare of the people** and establish a just society in India.
 
• The principle of **securing a living wage and decent standard of life** for workers is in line with the **socialist principles** of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "The State shall endeavor to secure the citizen a **Uniform Civil Code** throughout the territory of India," reads** Part IV, Article 44** of the Constitution. 
 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy incorporate the Gandhian principles of promoting** cottage industries** in rural areas and **organizing village panchayats.**

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true regarding the Indian monsoon and the Inter Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)?

options.text: The shift in the position of the ITCZ can influence the monsoon patterns in India.
ITCZ is located in the Indo-Gangetic plains during February.
The ITCZ is a phenomenon that occurs only during winter.
The ITCZ has no impact on the Indian monsoon.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The shift in the position of the ITCZ can influence the monsoon patterns in India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The (ITCZ) is a belt of low pressure near the equator where trade winds from the **Northern and Southern** Hemispheres come together.
 
• The shift in the position of the ITCZ can influence the **monsoon patterns** in India because it determines the location of the monsoon trough, which is a region of** low pressure** that attracts moisture from the surrounding areas.
 
• During summer, the ITCZ shifts northward towards the** Himalayas**, bringing moisture-laden winds from the **Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal **to India, resulting in the monsoon season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ITCZ is typically located over the** southern Indian Ocean** during this time.
 
• ITCZ is present **throughout the year,** but its position shifts with the seasons.
 
• ITCZ has a significant impact on the** Indian monsoon.**
 
• The** monsoon** is the buildup of **moist clouds **when moisture is released from the atmosphere as it cools down in the form of precipitation.
 
• The ITCZ is the region of the earth where **air convergence** is primarily observed throughout the year.

questions.question: Which country first introduced zero-based budgeting?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The US.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **US **first introduced **zero-based budgeting** in the **1960s.**
 
• In the 1960s, ZBB was formally initiated in the **Department of Agriculture of the USA** and turned out to be more popular in the 1970s.
 
• The Zero-Based Budgeting applicable today was developed at Texas Instruments Inc. in 1969 by Peter Pyhrr.
 
• Zero-based budgeting is a** budgeting method** in which all expenses must be justified for each new period.
 
• It starts from a** "zero base"** and every function within an organization is analyzed for its** needs and costs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India did adopt zero-based budgeting in **1987,** but it was not the first country to do so.
 
• Germany and the UK have also implemented zero-based budgeting, but again, they were **not the first countries** to introduce this method.
 
• Zero-based budgeting is often used by** businesses and governments **to identify areas of inefficiency and to reduce unnecessary expenses.
 
• There are two techniques for tracking expenses: **zero-based budgeting and traditional budgeting.**
 
• Zero-based budgeting aids managers in addressing a company's** lowest costs.**

questions.question: Which of the following is the main advantage of the import substitution policy?

options.text: It may make the indigenous industries more competitive.
It will help the consumers by providing them with unlimited choices.
It helps the nation achieve self-reliance.
It led to optimum allocation of resources.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**it helps the nation achieve self-reliance.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Import substitution policy** aims to promote **domestic industries** by **reducing imports** and **increasing domestic production.**
 
• This, in turn, helps the nation achieve **self-reliance** and** reduces dependence** on foreign countries for essential goods and services.

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form originating in **Kerala, India, **and is a** solo recital **by women.
 
• It is characterized by **graceful movements, **subtle expressions, and** intricate footwork.**
 
• The term Mohiniyattam is derived from the words **Mohini (meaning enchantress)** and** Attam (meaning dance).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It originated in **Odessa.**
 
 
 
• **Kathakali** is a highly stylized form of** dance-drama** that combines dance, music, and acting to depict stories from Indian epics.
 
 
• The origins of Kathakali can be traced to **Kerala** and other parts of southwest India.
 
• A **devotional dance,** kathakali is similar to **Bharatanatyam.**
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a dance-drama form that involves fast footwork, quicksilver movements, and graceful expressions.
 
 
• It comes from Kuchipudi, a village in the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh.**
